BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to emergency services communications systems; andamending RCW 38.52.510.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 38.52.510 and 1991 c 54 s 3 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) By December 31, 1998, each county, singly or in combinationwith adjacent counties, shall implement districtwide, countywide, ormulticountywide enhanced 911 emergency communications systems so thatenhanced 911 is available throughout the state. (2) The county shall provide funding for ((the enhanced 911)) anemergency services communication system as defined in RCW 82.14B.020 inthe county or district in an amount equal to the amount the maximum taxunder RCW 82.14B.030(1) would generate in the county or district or theamount necessary to provide full funding of the system in the county ordistrict, whichever is less. (3) The state enhanced 911 coordination office established by RCW p. 1 HB 191938.52.520 shall assist and facilitate enhanced 911 implementationthroughout the state.
